# `rtrim`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
rtrim(str)
```

Removes the trailing space characters from `str`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT rtrim('    SparkSQL   ');
```

Result:

```text
SparkSQL
```
